annotation.justification: The clause states that a recipient MAY employ workarounds while remaining conformant to the protocol if those workarounds are limited to the implementations at fault. The wording is unambiguous: it specifies a single condition (workarounds limited to the faulty implementations) under which the recipient may employ them. No alternative reasonable interpretations or missing constraints are evident.
